name: Prompt Security
tagline: Runtime security for GenAI usage and apps
description: Prompt Security protects employees' GenAI usage and homegrown LLM apps from prompt injection, data leakage, and policy violations. Acquired by SentinelOne (~$250M, August 2025), the platform now anchors SentinelOne's Singularity AI suite while continuing to be sold standalone.
pricingDetails: Enterprise quote-only. Sold standalone or as part of SentinelOne Singularity AI.
